base.content:
name: FerroDesign native feedback

on:
  push:
    branches: [feat/ferrodesign-editor]
    paths:
      - samples/FerroDesign/crates/**
      - samples/FerroDesign/Cargo.toml
      - samples/FerroDesign/Cargo.lock
      - src/Vello/FerroUI.Vello/**
      - src/FerroUI.Base/**
      - src/FerroUI.Controls/**
      - src/FerroUI.Themes.Simple/**
      - src/FerroUI.Themes.Fluent/**
      - .github/workflows/ferrodesign-native.yml
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Keep native compiler/pixel feedback independent of the complete browser run.
# The full browser workflow is still the source of browser validation evidence.
concurrency:
  group: ferrodesign-native-feedback-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  native:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: 1
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
      CARGO_TARGET_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/samples/FerroDesign/target
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_CODEGEN_UNITS: '16'
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: samples/FerroDesign
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
      - name: Configure runner-local toolchain paths
        run: |
          echo "CARGO_HOME=$RUNNER_TEMP/ferrodesign-tools/cargo" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RUSTUP_HOME=$RUNNER_TEMP/ferrodesign-tools/rustup" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: actions/cache/restore@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ferrodesign-tools/cargo/registry
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ferrodesign-tools/cargo/git
            samples/FerroDesign/target
          key: ferrodesign-native-feedback-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('samples/FerroDesign/**/Cargo.toml', 'samples/FerroDesign/Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            ferrodesign-native-feedback-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('samples/FerroDesign/**/Cargo.toml', 'samples/FerroDesign/Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.lock') }}-
            ferrodesign-build-${{ runner.os }}-v3-native-${{ hashFiles('samples/FerroDesign/**/Cargo.toml', 'samples/FerroDesign/Cargo.lock') }}-
      - name: Install pinned Rust and native font dependencies
        id: native_toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.99.0 --profile minimal --no-self-update
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y pkg-config libfontconfig1-dev libfreetype6-dev
      - name: Validate public unhinted glyph geometry and pixels
        # Record actual cache invalidation reasons without changing Cargo's
        # freshness decisions or any validation gate.
        env:
          CARGO_LOG: cargo::core::compiler::fingerprint=info
        run: cargo +1.99.0 test --locked --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p ferroui-vello --lib unhinted_ --jobs 1 -- --test-threads=1
      - name: Validate shared paragraph layout and native editing
        run: |
          # Exercise every independent editing suite even if an earlier one
          # fails. Preserve a failing step/job after collecting all results.
          failed=0
          cargo +1.99.0 test --locked --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p ferroui-base --lib paragraph --jobs 1 -- --test-threads=1 || failed=1
          cargo +1.99.0 test --locked --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p ferroui-controls --lib paragraph --jobs 1 -- --test-threads=1 || failed=1
          cargo +1.99.0 test --locked --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p ferroui-controls --lib text_box_tests:: --jobs 1 -- --test-threads=1 || failed=1
          cargo +1.99.0 test --locked --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p ferroui-controls --lib text_box_history:: --jobs 1 -- --test-threads=1 || failed=1
          exit "$failed"
      - name: Validate native editor and public renderer pixels
        # Keep independent application compiler/pixel feedback available if a
        # preceding framework test fails. Its failure still fails this job.
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.native_toolchain.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: cargo +1.99.0 test --locked -p ferrodesign-app --lib --jobs 1 -- --test-threads=1
      - uses: actions/cache/save@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830
        if: always()
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ferrodesign-tools/cargo/registry
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ferrodesign-tools/cargo/git
            samples/FerroDesign/target
          key: ferrodesign-native-feedback-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('samples/FerroDesign/**/Cargo.toml', 'samples/FerroDesign/Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
